        # Normalize to -1, 0, 1
        move_dx = max(-1, min(1, move_dx))

        move_dx = max(-1, min(1, move_dx))
        move_dy = max(-1, min(1, move_dy))

    # 3. Territory control: expand into unclaimed or own territory
    # Prefer moving toward unknown or unclaimed areas
    directions = [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]
